dedupe_keys.name: simulated heating energy demand for two residential neighbourhoods in flanders

description: This artificial dataset gives simulated heating energy demand for two neighbourhoods of single-family houses typical of Flanders, mimicking monitoring campaigns in occupied homes. It was published on Zenodo on 20 November 2024 by Katia Ritosa of KU Leuven, supplementing an Energy and Buildings article and part of a KU Leuven thesis. Houses were simulated with Dymola and the IDEAS library through TEASER, each varying in geometry, size, envelope, occupancy and gas heating system; one neighbourhood reflects a low-performing stock built before the 2006 EPBD, with envelopes from EPC data in four construction periods, and one a well-performing stock after 2006 from EPB reports. Houses are detached, semi-detached or terraced, one to three floors, with stochastic occupant behaviour and six gas boiler and hot water configurations. Coverage: two synthetic Flemish neighbourhoods, weather of Heverlee in 2016 at 10-minute resolution. Access: one 1.7 GB zip on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: simulated, not measured, data. Simulation uses: testing heat loss coefficient estimation and data-driven characterisation methods. Related records: TEASER and the Modelica IBPSA library.
